name: CUM LAUDE
source:
A visual novel where you're the only boy at an all-girls college, and every girl in the building wants a go at you. Students, teachers, the principal, the matron. All of them.

[Edited from [url=https://barleysugar.itch.io/cum-laude]itch.io[/url]]
